note: Grassy, partly wooded USACE campground on a point of Table Rock Lake's White River arm near Cassville, beside a marina, boat ramp and swim area. Electric sites sit at the tip of the point (23-31) and in the upper west loop (47-60); the non-electric south row looks through trees to the lake. --Claude
summary: Confirmed with changes: season May 1 - Sep 14 added; fees $16-28 confirmed with a per-type note; 61 sites, max 65 ft, all back-in; 22 electric (8 at 50 amp), 11 with sewer; holiday 3-night minimum added. Lakefront lead for point sites 22-25. Pin on the point is fine. Phone to add.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview) - lead for lakefront: on leaf-off imagery the point's outer sites 22 (55 ft), 23 (49 ft), 24 (40 ft) and 25 (61 ft) have pads within ~10-20 m of the riprap shore at the top of the bank, with no road, lot or beach between them and the water (the loop road and the marina lot are on their inland side). That meets the pads-within-a-pad-depth test on legible imagery. The swim area's exact spot isn't on any map read (it is not in front of 22-25 on imagery, which shows riprap there). If AWH prefers to hold, lakeview stands: the south row (3-16) sits 30-50 m up a wooded slope from the shore, below its own lane - a filtered view at best; sites 26-31 are inside the point loop behind the road; the west loop 47-60 is ~150 m inland in trees.
PHONE: rec.gov lists 417-271-3190 for Big M; the entry has no phone stored - suggest adding it.

HOOKUPS: the old note's '23 of 61 sites with 50A electric+water' was wrong - the catalog has 22 electric sites: 8 at 50 amp (23-29, 31), 13 at 30 amp (30, 47-51, 53-60), 1 at 15 amp (52); sewer on 11 of the 30-amp sites.
